title: Degradation of antibiotic fosfomycin by peroxymonosulfate/ferrate and simultaneous phosphate removal with in situ formed ferric nanoparticles
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00701A, Paper
Wen Jiang, Wenhao Lao, Zhe Xu, Yiping Feng, Jiuli Ruan
This study systematically investigates the peroxymonosulfate/ferrate (Fe(VI)/PMS) system for efficient degradation of the antibiotic fosfomycin (FOS) and simultaneous phosphate removal via in situ formed ferric nanoparticles. The Fe(VI)/PMS system achieved...
